scenes.heading: Index Names and Simplified Index Management
scenes.narration: Oak & Operations. Index Names and Simplified Index Management. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What three categories of indexes does the speech define?
scenes.heading: An out-of-the-box index, a customization of an out-of-the-box index, and a fully custom index
scenes.body: Section 5 says an index falls into three categories: out-of-the-box, customization of an out-of-the-box index, and fully custom.

scenes.question: What naming pattern does the speech show for customizing an out-of-the-box index?
scenes.heading: It appends -custom- and a number, as in damAssetLucene-8-custom-1
scenes.body: Section 5 says a customization of an out-of-the-box index appends -custom- and a number, for example damAssetLucene-8-custom-1.

scenes.question: How should a fully custom index be named according to the speech?
scenes.heading: It should use a prefix and a dot before the name, and end with -custom- and a version number, such as acme.product-1-custom-2
scenes.body: Section 5 says a fully custom index should use a prefix and dot to avoid conflicts and end with -custom- plus a version number.

scenes.question: How do you customize an out-of-the-box index in Cloud Service according to the speech?
scenes.heading: Copy its latest definition from a Cloud Service environment using the CRX DE Package Manager, rename it with the custom suffix, and add your changes
scenes.body: Section 5 says to copy the latest definition from a Cloud Service environment using CRX DE Package Manager, rename it with the custom suffix, and add changes.

scenes.question: If the cloud index you copied is of type elasticsearch, what two changes does the speech require?
scenes.heading: Change type to lucene and change async to async and nrt
scenes.body: Section 5 says that if the cloud index is of type elasticsearch, change type to lucene and async to async and nrt.

scenes.question: What does the speech say about introducing new full-text indexes on dam:Asset?
scenes.heading: It is strongly discouraged; instead customize damAssetLucene
scenes.body: Section 5 says introducing new full-text indexes on dam:Asset is strongly discouraged and recommends customizing damAssetLucene instead.

scenes.question: What is Simplified Index Management, and where does its diff-based configuration live?
scenes.heading: It uses a diff.index so out-of-the-box customizations and custom indexes can be defined with a single diff.json file, stored under _oak_index/diff.index with a placeholder .content.xml and a diff.json file
scenes.body: Section 5 says Simplified Index Management uses diff.index and a single diff.json under _oak_index/diff.index together with a placeholder .content.xml.
